name: Camp Mirage Wayne
description_short: Morning day camp in Wayne with over 40 weekly theme camps for kids ages 4 to 14, from sports and Lego to movie making and Nerf games. Camp runs 9 to noon, and a pay by the hour before and after camp program covers 8 am to 6 pm.

fees.name: Before and after camp care
fees.note: 8 to 9 am and noon to 6 pm, billed in 15 minute steps; $12 an hour for members

fees.name: Camp Mirage family membership
fees.note: Per family; gives 10% off morning camps and the $12 hourly care rate

refund_policy_summary: Full refund less a $20 processing fee through April 1; 50% back (less $20) through May 15, or 25% if only the 50% deposit was paid; no refunds after May 15. Changes cost $10.
notes: Summer Day Camp is for grades 2 to 8 in the fall (ages 7 to 14); Junior Day Camp is PreK to 1st grade (ages 4 to 6, must be 4 by the start of camp). Every theme camp page shows $200 a week. Lunch at noon is packed or bought as pizza with optional Canteen Cash. State licensed youth camp (NJ Department of Health camp ID 7203210). Registration opens January 5.

for_andrew: The site says 'Summer 2026 dates are now published' and that registration opens January 5, so it is either the finished 2026 season or 2027 with stale wording. I recorded the posted $200 a week as 2026 and listed no week by week sessions (each of 40 theme camps runs on its own weeks). Also the core camp is 9 to noon only. List it, or wait for 2027 dates?
